column1: # Template bugs (ADR 0010, #38): Golden render errors that the reference desktop editor (the pack's
# own mse.com, 2.6.3, under Wine) reports the same way, so they are bugs in the Template, not in this
# port. A Style whose every render error is listed here for its version, and whose Layout dumps
# match, has status "template-bug" instead of "unsupported". A new Style version drops out of the
# record until it is checked again. Fixes go upstream, never into the pack (ADR 0005).
